checked.claim: Board fined Facebook TRY 1.65 million for a photo API bug and late breach notification; unverified.
checked.evidence: Euronews/Reuters, 10 May 2019: the Authority fined Facebook 1.65 million lira over the September 2018 photo API bug, which let third-party apps access photos of around 300,000 Turkish users for 12 days; the Authority said Facebook 'not intervening in time' showed deficient technical measures. No mention of late notification in this case. A separate October 2019 decision fined Facebook TRY 1.6 million over the 'View As' breach (280,959 users), including TRY 550,000 for failing to notify (Daily Sabah, 3 October 2019).
checked.replacement: In April 2019 (announced 10 May 2019) the Board fined Facebook TRY 1.65 million over a September 2018 photo API bug that let third-party apps access photos of around 300,000 Turkish users for 12 days, finding inadequate technical measures. In October 2019 it fined Facebook a further TRY 1.6 million over the 'View As' breach affecting 280,959 users, partly for failing to notify the Authority.

checked.evidence: Reuters report republished by Euronews gives the amount, date and facts.

checked.claim: Board fined Yemeksepeti TRY 1.9 million for data security failures after a breach; unverified.
checked.evidence: Mondaq summary of Board Decision No. 2021/1324 of 23 December 2021: TRY 1.9 million under Art. 18(1)(b) for failing to take technical and administrative security measures; attackers exploited a web application vulnerability on 18 March 2021 and the breach went undetected for eight days; 21,504,083 users affected. Daily Sabah reported the fine on 7 February 2022.
checked.replacement: By Decision No. 2021/1324 of 23 December 2021 the Board fined the food delivery platform Yemeksepeti TRY 1.9 million for inadequate technical and administrative security measures after a March 2021 breach of data on about 21.5 million users that went undetected for eight days.

checked.evidence: Law firm summary of the Board decision with number and date.
